subject: Fleetwood Town knock Arsenal out of the Carabao Cup on penalties
title: Fleetwood's penalty shootout upset

lines.vo: The Premier League champions lost to League Two Fleetwood. Yes, really.
One-one, then Fleetwood won the shootout five-three.
Their winner, nineteen-year-old Conor Haughey, had never practised a penalty. Imagine if he had.
Jay Lynch saved Bruno Guimaraes' penalty. Fleetwood had a hero at each end.
lines.footage: Fleetwood vs Arsenal penalty shootout highlights

lines.vo: Max Dowman was sent off in the eighty-fifth minute. Arteta said a drone stopped play for eight minutes.
ESPN says no champion had lost a League Cup tie to a fourth-tier side. The drone did not help.
Your mates will never see this coming. Betting tips and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.
